d: Long, flowing jet black hair with a center part and wavy texture. Pale yellow, narrow, downcast eyes. An apparent young adult with a mature, somber expression. A lean, muscular build with a humanoid torso transitioning into a long, serpentine fish tail. The outfit consists of a dark teal and lime green armored bodice and a matching scale-like tail fin, complemented by dark teal bracers with lime green accents. Visible non-human traits include pointed elf-like ears, small green fin-like protrusions on the head, a lime green gem embedded in the chest, and a large, jagged dark teal fin extending from the back. BODY COLOR: Pale grey-tan skin on the upper body, transitioning to dark teal and lime green scales on the lower body. LEGS: Digitigrade, as the lower body is a singular, long serpentine fish tail ending in a large caudal fin.
